entities.name: Migloz
entities.description: Phyrexian beast of New Phyrexia that drilled out of the Furnace Layer into the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: Copper environment Migloz made his home.

events.summary: Migloz drills through the floor of the Furnace Layer and emerges in the Hunter Maze, making it his home.
events.quote: He drilled through the floor of his Furnace Layer birthplace
